## Goal

Add command to view the event history for a bug.

## Acceptance Criteria

- [ ] `docket log <id>` shows all events for a bug
- [ ] Display timestamp, event type, and relevant data
- [ ] Human-readable format
- [ ] Consider --json flag for machine-readable output

## Context

We have event logs (.jsonl files) but no way to view them through the CLI. Users should be able to see the history of a bug.

- 2026-01-13: Implementation complete. Added --json flag to src/commands/log.rs and updated main.rs CLI. Human-readable output shows timestamp, event type, and relevant data for each event. JSON output uses serde_json::to_string_pretty for machine-readable format. All 51 tests pass.
